dedupe_keys.name: jedeschule master data of all schools in germany api and csv

description: JedeSchule brings together the master data of all schools in Germany in one place: name, address, school type and operating body, with locations where the sources give them. It began in 2017 as jedeschule.de, an Open Knowledge Foundation Germany project with BildungsCent that scraped the school directories of the sixteen Länder; since 2019 volunteers from Code for Germany maintain the scrapers and collect fresh data once a week. The about page lists the source for each Land, such as school search services, geodata portals and downloadable directories; the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern data stay at 2023 because current lists are only sold. Coverage: schools in all sixteen Länder. Access: CSV download, an API and an interactive explorer; the scraper code is open on GitHub. Licence: the code is MIT; no licence is stated for the data, which come from the Länder sources. Caveats: fields vary by Land, some sources lack coordinates, and the original partnership and activity information is no longer collected. Simulation uses are school locations for shelter planning, hazard exposure and education continuity models. Related records: the US NCES school locations and the Global Library of School Infrastructure.
